item.description: Rescue teams have been searching since Saturday afternoon when a Burlington man fell from a small fishing boat off the coast of Ferrisburgh. According to authorities the man was not wearing a life jacket and his companion on the boat was unable to locate him after he submerged. Multiple emergency agencies including the Vermont State Police Underwater Recovery Team, the U.S. Coast Guard and a U.S. Border Patrol airplane crew have deployed in the search.

A new seven hundred-mile motorcycle loop opened in the Adirondacks, starting and ending in Westport, New York. The ADK BDR-X route passes through towns like Saranac Lake and Old Forge. It promotes responsible riding and supports local communities along the way.

The Adirondack Economic Development Corporation launched a Nonprofit Business Accelerator program. It offers business planning and growth support to nonprofits across fourteen counties in northern New York. Executive Director Victoria Duley said stronger nonprofits mean a stronger Adirondack economy.

Brattleboro has launched Next Gen Brattleboro to attract eight hundred and two new working-age households by twenty thirty-two. The initiative focuses on affordability and workforce development to support local businesses and families. A one million dollar matching challenge from the Vermont Community Foundation will help fund this effort.
